# Repository collaboration metadata

Contribution templates support [brewpi-remix/brewpi-emulator-rmx](https://github.com/brewpi-remix/brewpi-emulator-rmx). The original [regression workflow](workflows/regression.yml) is published on main after local review and hosted verification. The [hosted record](../engineering/development/software-release-r2-hosted.md) identifies the verified commits, attempts, and nine required contexts; repository rules remain inactive.

The [R1 policy](../engineering/development/software-release-policy.md) freezes nine exact PR/main contexts and first candidate 0.0.1-rc.1. The [R2 execution record](../engineering/development/software-release-r2.md) describes actual checks, fail-closed receipts, isolated runtime boundaries, local validation, and separately recorded native hosted evidence. There is no release, deploy, scheduled soak, tag-write, or automatic-merge workflow. Do not start R3, publish a release, or activate repository rules.
